item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera packs her lunch for school on a hot summer afternoon. Which lunch choice best supports healthy eating?

options.A: A large plate of fried chips, because they taste good and are familiar
options.B: A moderate portion of fresh roti, dal, and seasonal cucumber salad, eaten calmly at lunchtime
options.C: A very large serving of fresh fruit, eaten late at night just before sleeping
options.D: A brightly coloured packet of sweets, because the wrapper looks attractive
